tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Lium documentation for pages matching the query. Optionally filter by audience (providers, validators, pod-users, developers).

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Return the raw Markdown source for a documentation page. Accepts a full URL, absolute slug (e.g. /providers/quickstart), or basename (e.g. quickstart). On tie among basenames, prefers pages in audience order: Providers > Validators > Renters > Developers.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
